method: Deterministic local regression tests and synthetic OCR fixtures; no additional live model requests or changes to user settings/running applications

regressions.ocrCropEdges: Clip the full box against image bounds before normalization. Partially visible negative-origin boxes keep only their visible area; fully outside boxed text is discarded rather than becoming plain text.
regressions.scrollCancellation: Session cancellation is nonblocking, propagates the parent context, and is checked after native acquisition/stitching/encoding. A finishing export remains cancelable after detachment; session and epoch ownership is checked before storing its image.
regressions.settingsTransactions: Configuration loading, saving, autostart rollback, shutdown, and history writes use one transaction boundary. Configuration publication and old-task invalidation occur under the same state lock.
regressions.settingsAndCopyCallbacks: Delayed saves, autostart reads and original-copy feedback cannot affect a newer settings session or capture. Initial loading blocks saving default values. Begin/Cancel scrolling operations are ordered at the frontend boundary without serializing Finish/Step.
regressions.codexNotifications: Only consumed asynchronous notifications are deferred, at most 256 messages or 4 MiB. Consumed slots release payload references. Cancellation wins over buffered delivery; unrelated notification shapes and already-rejected server requests are ignored.
regressions.codexState: Model cursors are fully cycle-checked. Account revision changes invalidate authentication/default-model caches and prepared-session eligibility, including updates arriving during RPC completion.
regressions.codexCompletion: Streaming deltas remain immediate. A completed notification cannot turn a subsequent rejected turn/start acknowledgement into success. When completion precedes acknowledgement, confirmation waits at most 250 ms and failure retains partial output without replay.
regressions.configRecovery: A null configuration root is invalid and can recover the valid backup. Missing hotkey registration handles are retried even if the key text is unchanged; failure rolls back only new registrations.

ocrCompatibilityRecheck.reference: Existing stock-engine JSON for six local synthetic fixtures; compare complete normalized text and boxes on two passes
ocrCompatibilityRecheck.interpretation: Compatibility and quality recheck while other regression tests were running. Timing varies substantially under load; not a controlled speed comparison. Original models, image resolution and orientation detection are unchanged.
